elements.label: Table 1.1
elements.title: Dataset example with six entities and four attributes
elements.details:
| Semester  | Instructor | Class Size | Rating           |
|-----------|------------|------------|------------------|
| Fall 2020 | Smith      | 30         | Highly recommended|
| Spring 2021 | Johnson  | 25         | Recommended      |
| Fall 2021 | Lee        | 28         | Not recommended   |
| Spring 2022 | Smith    | 32         | Highly recommended|
| Fall 2022 | Johnson    | 27         | Recommended      |
| Spring 2023 | Lee      | 29         | Not recommended   |
elements.summary: This table shows a structured dataset with six entities distinguished by semester. Each entity has four attributes: Semester, Instructor, Class Size, and Rating, illustrating how datasets are organized for analysis.
